title: Time Series Forecasting via Reasoning: A Slow-Thinking Approach with Reinforcement Fine-Tuned LLMs

claim.summary: Time-R1 trains forecasting reasoning with supervised long-CoT warmup and GRIP reinforcement optimization, using temporal and structural rewards.

modules.name: Reinforcement fine-tuning for temporal reasoning
modules.scope_reason: The contribution changes the language model policy rather than adding a deployed tool orchestration module.
